g.text: Reaeration and deoxygenation compete to form a downstream oxygen sag

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Streeter–Phelps example with constant rates and speed, complete initial mixing, and no additional loads. D=kdL0/(kr−kd)[exp(−kdt)−exp(−krt)]+D0exp(−krt);
DO=DOsat−D. Critical point maximizes deficit and satisfies krD=kdL. Photosynthesis, sediment demand, dispersion, and nitrification are omitted.
